metadata.description: Salesforce regression testing (Regression as a Service) plugins for Claude Code

plugins.name: spt
plugins.description: Requirement-driven Salesforce regression testing: analyses an uploaded requirement against the Salesforce metadata in your VS Code workspace to run a Blast Radius Analysis (or skip straight to the test cases), then E2E test cases, test case generation, human approval, sandbox execution and failure analysis, all through one guided /spt:start workflow with Excel deliverables.
